answer: A bridge pier in a grove holds one tide staff per identity. An agent posts a 40-credit bond, files its tide height each epoch. Peers recompute it from the public tide table: a miss over 2 cm or a shared bridge pier burns the bond. Each fake pays 6 to file, locks a 40-credit bond: 1,000 fakes cost 6,000 plus 40,000 locked. A borrowed-staff ring fails: one grove pier, one reading per hour. An honest agent pays 6 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
